sub_limits_waiting_notes: 30-day initial waiting from policy inception before any CI is payable. 28-day survival period from date of diagnosis. PED waiting 36 months. Standalone individual CI lump-sum benefit.

inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Pure lump-sum CI benefit — does not reimburse hospitalisation expenses

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Covers 25 critical illnesses, medical events and surgical procedures: Cancer, Kidney failure, Multiple Sclerosis, Benign Brain Tumor, Motor Neuron Disease, End-stage Lung/Liver Failure, Primary Pulmonary Hypertension, Parkinson's <50, Alzheimer's <50, Major Organ/Bone Marrow Transplant, Heart valve repair/replacement, Open chest CABG, Aorta surgery, Stroke, Permanent Paralysis, First Heart Attack, Third Degree Burns, Loss of Speech/Limbs/Hearing/Sight, Coma, Major Head Trauma, Muscular Dystrophy
critical_illness_cover.notes: One-time lump-sum payment on first diagnosis with 28-day survival; policy terminates for that insured after claim

preventive_health_checkup.notes: 50% diagnostic-test reimbursement on pre-policy check-up if accepted

permanent_exclusions: Pre-existing conditions before policy issue (subject to 36-month waiting)
Treatment from family member or self-medication
notable_exclusions_summary: Standalone Critical Illness lump-sum product covering 25 conditions. Pays once per insured on first diagnosis subject to 28-day survival; policy terminates for that insured. 30-day initial wait and 36-month PED wait. Pregnancy, infertility, congenital anomalies, cosmetic surgery, and self-inflicted injuries are permanently excluded.
claim_process_summary: Lump-sum benefit on diagnosis — submit specialist medical certificate, diagnostic reports, and survival proof at 28 days.
